Add document context to chunks that cannot stand alone, and only       to those. Keep the retrieval improvements — hybrid search and reranking — ahead of the chunking improvements in       your queue, because that is the order the evidence supports. And hold on to an evaluation set that lets you change       your mind cheaply when the corpus grows, the model changes, or the questions your users ask turn out to be       different from the ones you designed for.
